content.text: INFINITE Journey #DiscoverChile ¡Hola po! Welcome to Chile! Nice to have you here! Discover trends on our blog Discover breathtaking Landscapes Activities for all interests Discover the highlights of the month When does the snow season start in Chile? The Andes Mountains dress in white to offer a unique spectacle. From the modern ski resorts near Santiago to the magical volcanoes and hot springs in the south, you can enjoy snowboarding, skiing, and breathtaking landscapes. Plan your trip and let the magic of the Andes captivate you! Read more South America’s most beautiful autumn is in Chile Autumn in Chile offers some of South America’s most breathtaking landscapes: native forests, volcanoes, and mountains painted in a palette of reds, yellows, and golds. Check out the Chilean destinations with the most stunning scenery during this season! Photo: José Antonio Mena/Andeshandbook Read more Trekking in Southern Chile: 10 Must-Do Routes Trails that combine unique landscapes and untouched nature: this is trekking in southern Chile. From ancient forests to glaciers and mountains, each route reveals ecosystems, volcanoes, rivers, and lakes. We have gathered 10 routes of varying difficulty and duration so you can discover the fascinating nature of our territory. It’s not science fiction; it’s walking through Chile.
